lines.en: I roll forward in little bounces.
My round body crushes the gravel.
The wires on me sway.
I stop and bounce twice.

lines.zh: 停下来之后，我又滚起来。
lines.en: Stopped, then I roll on.
Sparks jump from my ear.
I roll around a sheet of iron.

lines.zh: 我撞了一下石头，弹了回来。
lines.en: I hit a stone and bounce back.
I bounce once and switch slopes.
I roll toward the mine.

lines.zh: 石头被我的电打得发麻。
lines.en: Stones numb under my current.
I slow and stop.
I sit and bounce lightly in place.
I crackle.
I coil my wires into a loop.
A ball, but electric.

lines.zh: 我在碎石堆里拱来拱去。
lines.en: I root around in the rubble.
My wires drag on the ground.
I hear something in the rock.
That might be useful.
I stop and bounce once.
I bounce once more.
I do like scrap.
These hills. I'm digging through them.
Current circles inside me.
I can't quite stay still.
I bounce up to face you.
You’re far taller than me.
I roll a little closer.

lines.zh: 我滚到跟前，电弧绕着外壳乱窜。
lines.en: I roll up close, arcs skittering around my shell.
I'm discharging. You backed off.

lines.zh: 这一下我真不是有心的。
lines.en: I truly didn’t mean it.

lines.zh: 我没打算电你，就是收不住。
lines.en: I didn't mean it. I can't hold it in.

lines.zh: 我控制不住，我退开一圈。
lines.en: I can't control it. I roll back a circle.
Better now?
I circle wide. You've stopped.

lines.zh: 你停下了，我便不再动弹。
lines.en: You stopped. I won't move either.
We just stare at each other.
I tilt my body.
I know this move.

lines.zh: 我把身子偏一偏，你的头也偏了。
lines.en: I tilt my body. Your head tips too.
You tilted too. We're alike.
The blow sends me bouncing.
A string of sparks bursts off me.

lines.zh: 一击把我弹飞，滚了两滚。
lines.en: The blow sends me flying. Two rolls.
A wire snaps.
Two rolls before I steady.
Just steady, and the current scrambles.

lines.zh: 一根电线崩断，我没出声。
lines.en: A wire snaps. I make no sound.
No sound, and I can still roll.
I can still roll. I gather charge slowly.
I’ve noted that hit.
I smell it. Scrap!
Scrap! Is that for me?

lines.zh: 既是给我的，我就滚过去。
lines.en: For me, then. I roll over.
I reach it and bite down.
Bit down. Tastes like metal.
A metallic tang. Just right.

lines.zh: 这东西合我胃口，再来些。
lines.en: This suits me. More?
After this I might evolve.

lines.zh: 吃下这些也许就进阶了，你让开些。
lines.en: This might evolve me. Give me room.

lines.zh: 我嚼东西的时候会放电。
lines.en: I discharge while I chew.

lines.zh: 我嚼东西时会放电，别靠太近。
lines.en: I discharge while I chew. Don't get too close.
Don't crowd me. I'm not done eating.

lines.zh: 你一贴上来，就吃了记电。
lines.en: You touched me and took a shock.
I bounce off too.

lines.zh: 中间已经隔开了一小段。
lines.en: There’s a gap between us now.

lines.zh: 隔开一段后，我把头晃了晃。
lines.en: A gap between us, and I shake my head.
I shake my head. The wires still crackle.
I can't control the current either.

lines.zh: 我没想电你，手还麻着吗？
lines.en: I didn't mean to shock you. Still numb?
Is it numb? I'll move off.
Then it won't happen.

lines.zh: 退开就没事了，别再跟来。
lines.en: Away from me it's fine. Don't follow.

lines.zh: 我们这一族，靠进化长大。
lines.en: Our kind grow through evolution.

lines.zh: 我以后会变成别的样子。
lines.en: I'll become something else later.
Mamemon, Shootmon, Tekkamon.
For now this is what I am.

lines.zh: 眼下仍是这副圆样子，我弹了弹。
lines.en: Still this round shape. I bounce.
I bounce, and sparks fly again.
Sparks again. I have to stop.
So I stop and keep waiting.
I can still eat more scrap.

lines.zh: 我还能再啃些废铁，你等等。
lines.en: I can eat more scrap. Wait.
At the scrap, I open my mouth and bite.
My teeth ring on metal.
Bitten. I chew.
I chew. I can't swallow it.
It sticks. Too big a chunk.
I spit it out and bite again.

lines.zh: 吐掉重咬一口，这回咬开了。
lines.en: Spit and bite again. This time it gives.

lines.zh: 这次可以了，我滚开一点。
lines.en: It works. I roll aside.
Bits of iron still cling to me.

lines.zh: 碎铁还沾在身上，我接着翻。
lines.en: Bits of iron still on me. Keep digging.
Something's moving nearby.

lines.zh: 那边有动静，我扭身过去。
lines.en: Something moved. I turn.
The current surges.

lines.zh: 电流猛地窜高，你被盯上了。
lines.en: The current surges. You're marked.
Seen clearly: you're not scrap.
Then you're a target.

lines.zh: 既然不是废铁，那就当靶子。
lines.en: Not scrap, then. You're the target.
I roll. Faster and faster.
Current leads the way.
You leap back, and I roll harder.
You retreat. I chase.

lines.zh: 你现在在前面，我看见你了。
lines.en: You're ahead now. I see you.
I roll around it. You're running.
I roll faster.

lines.zh: 地上的碎石在我下面弹。
lines.en: Gravel spits out beneath me.

lines.zh: 我滚起来比你快，眼看就贴上了。
lines.en: I roll faster than you run. Closing in.
I'm closer. You look back.

lines.zh: 你回了一次头，随即拐弯。
lines.en: You glance back, then turn the corner.
I hit the wall and bounce back.

lines.zh: 撞墙弹回之后，我重新加速。
lines.en: Off the wall and back, I gather speed again.
You raise an arm. The current arrives first.
The shock pulls your hand in.
Your hand slows, and I'm on you.

lines.zh: 趁你空档撞上去，轮子没停。
lines.en: I ram the gap. Still rolling.
I ram, current sheeting my body.
I can't stop. Thunderbolt!
The flash lights the stones.
The shock drives you back.

lines.zh: 你被电退，我这边同样被弹飞。
lines.en: The shock drives you back. I'm flung off too.

lines.zh: 滚到石堆边，我借力弹起。
lines.en: I roll to the rock pile and bounce up off it.
Two rolls, then I push up again.
Good. I roll faster.

lines.zh: 我加速滚动，电线抽得呼呼响。
lines.en: I speed up, wires whipping.
The wires whip. You dodge.
Still charged; I'll roll at you again.

lines.zh: 还能再撞一回，电还没用完。
lines.en: One more charge. There's current left.
I roll into these mountains.
I roll into the hills, bouncing as I go.
Current lights the ground under me.
This hillside is all crushed slag.

lines.zh: 这片石头堆里，兴许藏着矿。
lines.en: All this stone. Maybe ore inside.
Maybe ore. I'll do a lap first.
I hit it and bounce back.

lines.zh: 一头撞上又弹开，我换条路。
lines.en: I hit and rebound. Try another route.
I see something ahead.
Not stone. I roll closer slowly.
The current gathers.

lines.zh: 电光在壳上聚拢，我蓄好了势。
lines.en: Current gathers on my shell. I'm ready.

lines.zh: 火烤得我外壳发烫，我弹来弹去。
lines.en: Fire heats my shell and I bounce about.

lines.zh: 我摔在地上，又弹了起来。
lines.en: I hit the ground and bounce back up.

lines.zh: 水把电导走了，我一时提不起来。
lines.en: The water drains my current away.
The blast throws me high.

lines.zh: 弹丸打在我的外壳上，弹开了。
lines.en: A round hits my shell and ricochets.
Light forces the current back.
No scrap, and my current fades.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我反而更精神。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and I feel stronger.
I tumble down and down.
